title: Crime Aid
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Crime Aid,' the office faces a theft that prompts Michael to organize a charity auction called crime-aid to fight poverty. The episode features office interactions, a charity auction with notable items like Springsteen tickets, and personal conflicts among characters, including Dwight's confrontation with Phyllis and Jim's update on Pam's engagement.

main_threads.thread: Michael organizes a charity auction called crime-aid to fight poverty, featuring items like Springsteen tickets and a weekend at David Wallace's house.
